title: Continual Graph Memory for Adaptive Recommendation under Intent Drift
abstract: arXiv:2609.04651v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies adaptive recommendation under intent drift, where feedback from each recommendation outcome can reveal whether the relational evidence used for ranking is useful, missing, or misleading. While Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provide essential semantic structure to handle these shifts, traditional KG-enhanced systems treat the graph as a static retrieval substrate, making it brittle to evolving intents, noisy metadata, and recurring failure patterns. This paper proposes CGM-Rec, a continual graph memory framework for adaptive recommendation. CGM-Rec treats the graph state as a writable memory and maintains two complementary components. Therein, a Semantic Graph Memory is updated conservatively through quality-gated typed operations for storing stable and high-confidence relational knowledge. Meanwhile, an Episodic Lesson Memory acts as a fast reactive memory that learns recent outcomes, failure cases, and corrective hints. Durin

translated_title: 面向意图漂移下自适应推荐的持续图记忆框架
translated_abstract: 本文研究意图漂移下的自适应推荐问题，其中每次推荐结果的反馈可以揭示用于排序的关系证据是有用的、缺失的还是误导性的。虽然知识图谱为处理这些变化提供了必要的语义结构，但传统的知识图谱增强系统将图视为静态的检索基底，使其在面对不断演变的意图、嘈杂的元数据和重复出现的失败模式时表现脆弱。本文提出了CGM-Rec，一个用于自适应推荐的持续图记忆框架。CGM-Rec将图状态视为可写的记忆，并维护两个互补的组件。其中，语义图记忆通过质量门控的类型化操作进行保守更新，用于存储稳定且高置信度的关系知识；同时，情景教训记忆充当快速反应记忆，学习近期的推荐结果、失败案例和纠正性提示。
tldr: 提出CGM-Rec持续图记忆框架，将图状态视为可写记忆，通过保守更新的语义图记忆与快速反应的情景教训记忆两个互补组件，实现意图漂移下的自适应推荐。
en_tdlr: Proposes CGM-Rec, a continual graph memory framework that treats the graph state as writable memory, combining a conservatively-updated Semantic Graph Memory with a fast-reactive Episodic Lesson Memory to achieve adaptive recommendation under intent drift.
